metadata.description: Collection of plugins for Claude Code

plugins.name: agent-meeting-room
plugins.description: Tracks Claude Code sessions and agent processes in the Agent Meeting Room system

plugins.name: documentation-generator
plugins.description: Generate comprehensive project documentation through interactive dialog with templates

plugins.name: git-commit
plugins.description: Streamlined git commit and push with auto-generated commit messages

plugins.name: vue-reorder
plugins.description: Refactor Vue 3 SFCs for readability: reorder sections, organize script, improve naming

plugins.name: js-refactor-logic
plugins.description: Refactor JavaScript logic: code splitting, design patterns, ES6+ modernization

plugins.name: ts-refactor-logic
plugins.description: Refactor TypeScript logic: code splitting, type improvements, design patterns

plugins.name: vue-refactor-logic
plugins.description: Refactor Vue 3 script logic: composables extraction, code splitting, Vue patterns

plugins.name: vue-development-skill
plugins.description: Vue 3/Nuxt 3 development skill with TDD workflow and QA-first approach. Produces JSON reports for agent handoff.

plugins.name: owasp-security-audit
plugins.description: Multi-agent OWASP Top 10 security audit with technical and stakeholder reports

plugins.name: ncsc-security-audit
plugins.description: Multi-agent NCSC ICT-beveiligingsrichtlijnen audit met technische en stakeholder rapporten

plugins.name: technical-specifications
plugins.description: Interactive agent for collecting and refining technical specifications through guided dialogue

plugins.name: user-story-generator
plugins.description: Generate INVEST-compliant user stories from functional specifications and personas with Gherkin acceptance criteria

plugins.name: persona-generator
plugins.description: Create detailed user personas through interactive dialogue for user story development

plugins.name: functional-specifications
plugins.description: Generate functional specifications from business case and personas through interactive dialogue

plugins.name: business-case-management
plugins.description: Generate, update, review, delete, and transform business cases in four formats (one-pager, lean canvas, short-form, full)

plugins.name: xplore
plugins.description: Interactively explore a user's idea through structured questioning until all dimensions are covered

plugins.name: skill-manager
plugins.description: Create, update, rename, and delete skills with structured interview process and shared foundation compliance

plugins.name: persona-management
plugins.description: Create user personas through interactive dialogue from a business case or guided questioning, with iterative review

plugins.name: competitive-analysis
plugins.description: Autonomous competitive analysis using SWOT, Porter's Five Forces, TOWS matrix, and strategic positioning. Researches competitors via web, produces Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.

plugins.name: market-sizing
plugins.description: Autonomous TAM/SAM/SOM market sizing with top-down and bottom-up triangulation. Researches market data via web, produces growth projections, segmentation breakdowns, and Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.

plugins.name: trend-analysis
plugins.description: Autonomous trend analysis with PESTEL scans, trend classification (megatrend/trend/fad), impact assessment, weak signals, scenario sketches, and Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.

plugins.name: customer-segmentation
plugins.description: Autonomous customer segmentation with multi-dimensional profiling, MASDA validation, targeting matrix, positioning map, and activation roadmap. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.

plugins.name: industry-benchmarking
plugins.description: Autonomous industry benchmarking comparing performance against P25/P50/P75 and best-in-class. Gap analysis, composite scorecards, maturity assessment, and improvement roadmaps with Mermaid diagrams and optional PNG export.

plugins.name: survey-design
plugins.description: Design survey questionnaires with sampling plans, bias review, and analysis plans. Export to Qualtrics (QSF), XLSForm, SurveyJS, or CSV. Analyzes provided results with NPS/CSAT/CES/SUS scoring. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.

plugins.name: stakeholder-mapping
plugins.description: Autonomous stakeholder mapping using Power/Interest Grid, Salience Model, Engagement Assessment, and Onion Diagram. Produces stakeholder registers, engagement strategies, and communication plans with Mermaid diagrams and optional PNG export.

plugins.name: influence-diagramming
plugins.description: Autonomous influence diagramming mapping relationships, influence flows, and power dynamics between stakeholders. Produces influence matrices, centrality analysis, coalition detection, and strategic recommendations with Mermaid diagrams and optional PNG export.

plugins.name: raci-matrix
plugins.description: Autonomous RACI matrix creation with variant support (RASCI, RACI-VS, DACI, RAPID). Validates against 15 anti-patterns, produces workload analysis, governance health scoring, and communication plan skeleton. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.

plugins.name: value-proposition-canvas
plugins.description: Autonomous Value Proposition Canvas using Strategyzer's framework. Customer Profiles (jobs, pains, gains), Value Maps (products, pain relievers, gain creators), fit assessment with scoring, and multi-segment support. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.

plugins.name: cost-benefit-analysis
plugins.description: Autonomous cost-benefit analysis with NPV, BCR, IRR, payback period, and break-even calculations. Multi-alternative comparison, sensitivity analysis with scenarios, intangible monetization, and risk assessment. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.

plugins.name: roi-modeling
plugins.description: Autonomous ROI modeling with 6 variants (basic, annualized, risk-adjusted, expected, multi-period, intangibles). Industry-specific models (IT TCO, Marketing ROAS/CAC/CLV, Training Phillips, Product R&D). Scenario modeling and sensitivity analysis with Mermaid diagrams and optional PNG export.

plugins.name: problem-solution-fit
plugins.description: Autonomous problem-solution fit analysis using Lean Startup PSF, Customer Forces Canvas, DVF assessment, Riskiest Assumption Testing, and Evidence Quality Ladder. Fit scorecards, validation experiment designs, and pivot/persevere recommendations. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.

plugins.name: financial-forecasting
plugins.description: Autonomous financial forecasting with revenue, expense, cash flow, P&L projections, and unit economics. Multiple methods (driver-based, bottom-up, top-down). Scenario modeling and sensitivity analysis with Mermaid diagrams and optional PNG export.

plugins.name: vision-crafting
plugins.description: Autonomous vision statement crafting using Golden Circle, Moore's Positioning, Working Backwards (PR/FAQ), and Product Vision Board. Multi-level alignment, quality scoring, and anti-vision positioning. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.

plugins.name: okr-definition
plugins.description: Autonomous OKR definition with cascading/alignment across company, team, and individual levels. Committed vs aspirational classification, 0-1.0 scoring, CFR companion framework, and 20-mistake quality validation. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.

plugins.name: theme-roadmapping
plugins.description: Autonomous theme-based product roadmapping with Now/Next/Later, time-horizon, and swimlane formats. Strategic themes, initiative mapping, audience-specific views (executive, team, customer), and dependency analysis. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.

plugins.name: prioritization
plugins.description: Autonomous prioritization with RICE, ICE, Value vs Effort, Kano, and Weighted Scoring frameworks. Cross-framework comparison, conflict resolution, and Now/Next/Later bucket assignment. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.

plugins.name: opportunity-scoring
plugins.description: Autonomous opportunity scoring using Ulwick's Opportunity Score (importance vs satisfaction), Teresa Torres' Opportunity-Solution Tree, and multi-criteria weighted scoring. JTBD-framed outcomes with priority landscapes. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.

plugins.name: go-to-market
plugins.description: Autonomous go-to-market strategy with ICP/personas, positioning and messaging, pricing/packaging, channel strategy (PLG/SLG/hybrid), 90-day launch plan, rollout waves, and success metrics. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.

plugins.name: readme-generator
plugins.description: Generate a comprehensive README.md by analyzing the codebase and validating findings with the user. Detects monorepos and generates root + sub-package README's.

plugins.name: brainstorming
plugins.description: Brainstorming and brainwriting skill applying classic rules, 6-3-5, reverse brainstorming, SCAMPER, round-robin, nominal group technique, silent brainstorming, crazy 8s, and HMW. Autonomous, facilitation, or documentation mode. Affinity clustering, multi-criteria evaluation, and Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.

plugins.name: mind-mapping
plugins.description: Generate a hierarchical mind map around a central topic with 5-8 main branches and configurable depth. Autonomous, transformation, or expansion mode. Classic, concept-map, and tree styles. Produces Mermaid mindmap diagrams with optional PNG export, a synced nested outline, and a per-branch keyword index.

plugins.name: concept-sketching
plugins.description: Generate low-fidelity concept sketches for a design challenge as structured concept briefs, storyboard panels, low-fi wireflows (Mermaid), key touchpoint specs, and annotations. Produces 2-4 variants side-by-side with comparison table. Autonomous, comparison, and elaboration modes. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.

plugins.name: affinity-diagramming
plugins.description: Bottom-up thematic clustering of unstructured items (research notes, interview quotes, brainstorm ideas, feedback) using the KJ method. Discovers emergent themes with evidence traceability, identifies patterns/tensions/gaps, flags outliers, and prioritizes clusters by signal strength. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.

plugins.name: hmw-framing
plugins.description: Transform a problem, pain point, insight, or research finding into 'How might we...' questions for ideation. Deconstructs input, applies multiple HMW lenses, produces 3-6 variants with scope and wording checks, recommends a best variant, and optionally breaks broad HMWs into sub-HMWs. Mermaid diagram with optional PNG export.

plugins.name: jtbd-analysis
plugins.description: Jobs-to-be-Done analysis for a product, feature, market, or segment. Produces formal main job statement, related/emotional/social jobs, Ulwick desired outcome statements, forces-of-progress analysis, competitive alternatives including non-consumption, and underserved-outcome opportunity signals. Synthesis or autonomous mode. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.

plugins.name: empathy-mapping
plugins.description: Empathy mapping for a persona or user segment across 6 quadrants (Dave Gray) or classic 4-quadrant (XPLANE). Synthesis mode extracts from research; autonomous mode infers with labeled assumptions. Surfaces tensions, evidence gaps, 3-5 synthesized insights, and top pain/gain highlights. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.

plugins.name: build-vs-buy-analysis
plugins.description: Structured build vs buy (vs hybrid / open-source / rent / non-consumption) analysis for a capability. Evaluates 7 criteria (strategic fit, TCO, time to value, control, risk, switching cost, opportunity cost) with weighted scoring tied to strategic importance. Produces scored decision matrix, TCO breakdown with ranges, recommendation with trade-off and risk, and reversal conditions. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.

plugins.name: dependency-mapping
plugins.description: Map dependencies between components, teams, deliverables, systems, or tasks. Every edge carries direction and type (hard-blocking / soft-blocking / enabling / data). Detects cycles with classification, surfaces hubs/sources/sinks, identifies single points of failure with blast radius, and computes critical path when durations are supplied. Mermaid flowchart and Gantt diagrams with optional PNG export.

plugins.name: cost-estimation
plugins.description: Cost estimation using three-point (PERT), analogous, parametric, and bottom-up techniques with optimistic / most-likely / pessimistic ranges. Produces category breakdown, risk-based contingency (10-40%), confidence labeling, and sensitivity analysis on top 3 cost drivers. Mermaid diagrams for cost breakdown, range, and sensitivity with optional PNG export.

plugins.name: timeline-estimation
plugins.description: Timeline estimation using three-point (PERT), analogous, parametric, and velocity-based techniques with O/M/P date ranges. Integrates with dependency-mapping for critical-path timelines, translates working days to calendar dates respecting holidays and freezes, recommends buffer, defines milestones with entry criteria, and assesses deadline probability when a deadline is supplied. Mermaid Gantt and range diagrams with optional PNG export.

plugins.name: regulatory-landscape-mapping
plugins.description: Map the regulatory landscape for a product/service/business across jurisdictions. Inventories regulations by domain (privacy, security, sectoral, payments, AI, consumer, accessibility, ESG, tax, export-control), assesses applicability and severity, surfaces overlaps and conflicts, flags upcoming changes, and scores net risk. Not legal advice. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.

plugins.name: data-flow-diagramming
plugins.description: Privacy-focused data flow diagramming. Maps entities, flows, data categories, GDPR legal basis, retention, and cross-border transfers. Flags high-risk conditions (special-category, children's data, international transfers, automated decisions), produces a RoPA-style register, and identifies DPIA needs. Not legal advice. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.

plugins.name: control-framework-mapping
plugins.description: Map controls against frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST CSF, NIST 800-53, CIS v8, PCI-DSS v4, HIPAA Security Rule, NIS2, ISO 27701, ISO 42001). Produces control inventory, mapping matrix, coverage counts, gap analysis with recommended controls and effort, maturity scoring, and cross-framework consolidation flagging high-leverage controls. Not a certified audit. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.

plugins.name: risk-matrix
plugins.description: Classic qualitative likelihood × impact risk matrix with 5×5 (or 3×3) grid, anchored scales, risk-appetite-adjusted thresholds, and explicit response recommendation (avoid / reduce / transfer / accept) per risk. Mermaid heat map with optional PNG export.

plugins.name: fmea
plugins.description: Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA / DFMEA). Per function: modes, effects, causes, controls, S/O/D scores (1-10 anchored), RPN, and AIAG-VDA Action Priority. Recommends actions targeting Severity/Occurrence/Detection with expected post-action scores and re-score delta. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.

plugins.name: monte-carlo-simulation
plugins.description: Monte Carlo simulation for cost / schedule / outcome uncertainty. Accepts input variables with distributions (triangular, PERT, uniform, normal, log-normal, discrete), runs 10k iterations, and produces P10-P95 percentiles, probability of meeting a threshold, sensitivity tornado, and contingency recommendation. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.

plugins.name: risk-register
plugins.description: Persistent risk register. Stable IDs, inherent + residual scoring, controls, response strategy, review cadence, history, and multiple views (top risks, by owner, by category, overdue, recently changed). Ingests from risk-matrix, fmea, monte-carlo-simulation, pre-mortem. Markdown + CSV export. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.

plugins.name: mitigation-strategy-planning
plugins.description: Plan mitigations for a set of risks. Response per risk (avoid / reduce / transfer / accept), concrete actions with owner / effort / cost / expected residual, cost-benefit check, roadmap (quick wins / structural / long-term), acceptance & transfer registers, and decision register feeding risk-register. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.

plugins.name: pre-mortem
plugins.description: Gary Klein pre-mortem. Stipulate failure at a horizon and retrospectively identify why. Elicits 10-20 failure modes across categories, clusters and scores Impact × Likelihood, produces preventive actions with leading indicators, and exports risks to risk-register / fmea / mitigation-strategy-planning. Autonomous mode + facilitator guide. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.

plugins.name: rapid-prototyping
plugins.description: Plan a rapid prototype to validate one specific assumption. Classifies the assumption (desirability / feasibility / viability / usability / technical / data), selects the cheapest technique (paper, wireflow, Wizard of Oz, concierge, landing-page, spike, pretotype), declares what will and will NOT be proven, pre-commits success / kill criteria, fixes a timebox, sequences follow-on work, and flags validity risks. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.

plugins.name: ab-hypothesis-framing
plugins.description: Frame A/B tests with falsifiable hypothesis, variants, pre-committed primary/secondary/guardrail metrics, MDE, sample size (formula shown), duration spanning a weekly cycle, peek policy, pre-committed decision rule, validity risks with mitigations, and ethics review. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.

plugins.name: metric-definition
plugins.description: Design a coherent metric system: one user-value North Star, 3-5 decomposing input drivers, leading vs lagging per driver with time lag, guardrails with tolerances, counter-metrics per leading metric, and per-metric operational definitions (formula, source, population, exclusions, owner, cadence). Measurement readiness flags instrumentation gaps. Mermaid metric tree with optional PNG export.

plugins.name: performance-budgeting
plugins.description: Define performance budgets (latency percentiles, throughput, payload sizes, Core Web Vitals) with per-component allocations that sum, measurement plan (RUM/synthetic/CI/load test), violation policy (warn/block/rollback/page), degradation strategy, and device/network/geography segmentation. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.

plugins.name: sla-definition
plugins.description: Define customer-facing Service Level Agreements: per-tier availability, performance commitments, support response times by severity, remedy schedule (credits with claim procedure), explicit exclusions, measurement methodology, and reporting cadence. Distinguishes SLA (external) from SLO (internal, tighter). Not legal advice. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.

plugins.name: slo-sli-definition
plugins.description: Define internal SRE-style Service Level Objectives and Indicators per user-journey (availability, latency, correctness, freshness, durability, throughput). Sets SLO tighter than any SLA with buffer, error budget (time + events), fast + slow burn-rate alerts, and policy wiring budget state to concrete actions. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.

plugins.name: scalability-modeling
plugins.description: Model scalability for a service across multiple growth scenarios. Identifies the dominant bottleneck per scenario (CPU/memory/DB/cache/queue/network/external API), proposes scaling strategies targeting that specific bottleneck, produces a capacity plan with readiness, a cost model with cost-per-unit-of-load, and risks at scale. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.

plugins.name: security-requirements-classification
plugins.description: Classify data and functional assets by sensitivity, score CIA impact, derive per-tier required controls (authn/authz/encryption/logging/retention/review/masking/monitoring), write functional security requirements with test-how + failure-mode, generate abuse cases, and map requirements to framework control IDs. Not a security audit. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.

plugins.name: accessibility-requirements
plugins.description: Define accessibility requirements against WCAG 2.2 AA (default), AAA, EN 301 549, EAA, Section 508, ADA. Produces per-feature Given/When/Then criteria, assistive-technology support matrix per platform, combined automated + manual + AT + user-testing plan, and remediation priority for existing products. Not a conformance audit. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.

plugins.name: maintainability-criteria
plugins.description: Define CI-checkable maintainability criteria: complexity caps, test coverage per layer with critical paths named, documentation requirements, modularity rules, review gates, non-zero refactoring budget, dependency policy with SLAs, deprecation playbook, and legacy tolerance with drawdown schedule. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.

plugins.name: traceability-matrix
plugins.description: Build a requirements traceability matrix linking goals → requirements → stories → tests → deployed artifacts with stable IDs, controlled link types (implements / verifies / validates / satisfies / mitigates / decided-by), forward + backward views, per-direction coverage with explicit orphan lists, change-impact helpers, regulatory overlay, and Markdown + CSV exports. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.

plugins.name: impact-analysis
plugins.description: Analyze the impact of a proposed change across a traceability graph. Names affected artifacts (no 'many'), classifies blast radius (local / cross-team / external / enterprise), scores change-level risk per factor (reversibility / detection / blast / schedule / compliance), estimates effort per team, proposes phased rollout with gates and rollback, plans communication per audience, and surfaces residual uncertainties for discovery. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.

plugins.name: coverage-analysis
plugins.description: Compute multi-dimensional coverage (Req→Test / Goal→E2E / Risk→Control / NFR→Implementation / Regulatory→Control / Abuse-case→Control). Detects false coverage (tests without assertions, trivial assertions, mocked system-under-test), identifies duplicated coverage, computes risk-weighted %, and produces prioritized gap-analysis actions. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.

plugins.name: baseline-management
plugins.description: Capture, compare, release, and roll back named baselines of a requirements / artifact set. Released baselines immutable with content hashes. Diff classifies changes as backward-compatible / breaking / editorial. Evidence bundle per released baseline. Append-only audit trail. Supports ISO 13485 / IEC 62304 / FDA / aerospace / automotive retention requirements. Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
